explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/902: f(n) is the least number of vertices of a tournament in which every n-set is dominated by some other vertex; estimate f(n).  is sInf of m ≥ n admitting a tournament on Fin m with HasPropertyS (some x ∉ E beats every vertex of E). Excluding m < n, where S_n holds vacuously, is correct. The statement asks for a Θ-estimate, a reasonable reading of 'estimate' given the gap between n2^n and n²2^n. Faithful.
